known_parity_gaps: A real SL201, SL202, SL203, or SL205 row calls make_finding with the fingerprint omitted. Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits the finding.
check_checkpoint stops at the first family that would call make_finding. Python runs every family and sorts the combined list.
An empty gap or divergence list with max_findings -1 takes the overflow path. Rust returns the codec error. Python emits an overflow finding.
A float or list used where Python would call str is a typed error. Rust does not invent the Python repr.
A seq string of Unicode digits is a typed error. Python str.isdigit accepts Unicode Nd.
